name: xiaoa-knowledge-coach
description: Gamified knowledge coach that turns any knowledge base into an interactive level-based quiz H5 with RAG-grounded explanations, adaptive review and learning diagnostics. Delivers a permanent public cloud link (https://<id>.app.workbuddy.link, independent of whether the local machine is on) plus a WeChat-scannable QR poster, is responsive on both PC and mobile, and ships a WeChat readiness check (wechat_check.py) that verifies whether the link actually opens inside WeChat's in-app browser.

displayDescription.en: Turns any knowledge base into a level-based quiz H5 with AI read-aloud; delivers a WeChat-scannable QR poster and a permanent link, responsive on PC and mobile.
displayDescription.zh: 把知识库变闯关 H5：AI 语音朗读、微信可扫海报、双端自适应与微信可打开性体检。
